about: The loop-storm 100 ms window (ARCHITECTURE-P3C D3, §7 W0 and W0h, §10.1 accept.p3c.hot-path), recorded from the unchanged engine at commit cad4ac9 before any P3c code: the P1-profile storm world of accept.p2.loop-storm-bounded (two NF-C2960 on the stage-P2 catalog, three parallel cables at 40 s, PC1 pings at 41 s), runFor(100 ms) from the ping. The scheduler events dispatched, the trace events per kind, the SHA-256 of every event line and per-10 ms digests. The byte proof of [S40]: a hot-path change must leave it exactly. Re-record only with NF_RECORD_P3C_STORM_WINDOW=1 (the architect).
